GBM snATAC Atlas v2026-11-05 — Enhancer Candidates v4 scoring on v6 matrix

53 patients × 9 cohorts × ~1.57M nuclei × 1,987,571 union peaks. Top-1000 peaks per cell type, ranked by primary_score = (spec_pct + strength_pct) / 2. 28,818 peaks are NOVEL (contributed by Pai 2025; cross-cohort replication ceiling of 3 — not 9 — for those peaks). Fragment_eligible_patient_cap column shows the per-peak ceiling (53 for existing, 16 for novel).
Methodology note: primary_score ranks peaks within-cell-type by percentile-rank mean of (log2FC_top_vs_next, strength_frags_per_cell_wn). NOVEL peaks (orange badge) have reduced replication coverage — only 3 cohorts (pai_2025, sojka_2025, sundaram_2024) are fragment-mode and can be counted at novel peak coordinates; the other 6 cohorts zero-fill at those peaks. Interpret n_cohorts in that context. AMP badge: non-malignant peak within ±1 Mb of a known amplicon (diagnostic only, not scored).
